sql: SELECT "status"."station_id" AS k, ("status"."bikes_available" - "status"."docks_available") AS m1 FROM "status" WHERE ("status"."bikes_available" - "status"."docks_available") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: status.bikes available at station minus empty docks available at station
why: bikes available at station - empty docks available at station: both in count and of the same kind (stocks) on the same station availability snapshot at a minute
rank status rows by bikes available at station minus empty docks available at station

sql: SELECT "status"."station_id" AS k, "status"."docks_available" AS m1 FROM "status" WHERE "status"."docks_available" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: rank status rows by empty docks available at station

sql: SELECT "status"."station_id" AS k, "status"."bikes_available" AS m1 FROM "status" WHERE "status"."bikes_available" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: rank status rows by bikes available at station
